{{Top|leg}}
An '''airtight fabric oversuit''' was part of a [[cold assault stormtrooper]]s standard equipment. Cold assault stormtroopers were issued with the airtight fabric oversuit that was worn over their [[Snowtrooper armor/Legends|armor]] and provided the trooper extra protection from cold weather elements.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
